name: atlas-pilot
prompt_prefix: Navigate the code with Read, Grep and Glob, and with one extra tool, the code passport `atlas`, run through Bash (only these two commands are allowed, nothing else): `python {repo_root}/pilot_atlas.py ref <id> [<id> ...]` prints a passport of a symbol (address file:line, signature, call sites, members, subclasses, tests); an id is a bare name (class, function, method, module constant) or `<repo path>::<Symbol>` for an exact one; and `python {repo_root}/pilot_atlas.py map <repo file or module path>` prints a skeleton of a file or module. Use it to find and understand code instead of reading whole files, then Read to verify. Paths in its output are relative to your working directory.
